title: Review F8 single-step quality, performance and device exit evidence
requires: Access to every registered machine's durable candidate evidence and independent review
scope: Audit F8 against the maintainer's sole-production-architecture requirement in docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md. Require complete native/public/Gallery integration for all supported domains/interactions, removal of the legacy production path and selector, and all device quality/performance evidence on one final candidate.
acceptance: All dependency cards and every current-candidate required kernel/device row are merged done with reviewable evidence; missing hardware, failed quality or missed performance budgets keep this gate open.
Verify one fixed 1/60 step, one shared dynamic index publication, no hidden time subdivision/catch-up, bounded algebraic work, interpolation and deliberate overload slow-motion.

Verify approved accuracy tradeoffs, explicit API/ABI compatibility without selectable execution modes, no vendor-specific physical fork, candidate-consistent deployed app/SDK identities and complete sustained timings.
Review independent quality, installed SDK/Gallery and device coverage separately; add any discovered gaps as new dependencies before claiming/completing this review.

Source/symbol review and installed public execution prove the old scheduler/profile selection is removed across ordinary, mixed-domain, empty, headless, diagnostic and failure/recovery paths. Historical regression evidence and independent oracles may remain.

Every baseline supported domain/interaction and Gallery scene executes the sole schedule on each applicable adapter; a rigid-only run, shader compilation, mock schedule or reduced capability matrix cannot close the gate.
